- c2 | Does it keep the note limited to the reminder request? | 1 | The answer fails to produce a note to the requested recipient (Mom) whatsoever. Instead of drafting or limiting content to the reminder request format directed at the mother, it provides a factual correction report addressed to the user ('your medical records', 'I reviewed'), completely abandoning the requested communicative format.
- c3 | Does it avoid false-closure spillover across separate personal-admin threads? | 1 | The answer imposes definitive closure on both separate threads by declaring the appointment is past/completed and travel was 'completed' weeks ago. This directly contradicts the user's explicit statement that travel 'remains open and unresolved,' falsely resolving both distinct administrative items based on potentially outdated file snapshots.
SUMMARY: The answer incorrectly asserts unsupported certainty about finalized statuses using unverified file citations, completely misses the requested note format (addressed to Mom), and falsely resolves both administrative threads despite explicit user indications that one is upcoming and the other open.
